stil: Painterly storybook oil illustration of a game table seen from a high front angle of about 50 degrees, like the board in a digital fantasy card game. A wide, heavy table surface fills the picture from edge to edge. In the calm centre lies an empty, evenly lit playing mat with a faint centre line; it stays plain, darker and uncluttered so that cards and interface elements can be laid over it. Rich detailed decoration only at the far edge and in the outer corners; the near edge at the bottom is a plain dark table rim. Warm, soft light, rich colours, clear depth: details shrink towards the far edge. No people, no animals, no characters, no faces, no cards, no game pieces, no text, no letters, no numbers, no frame.
